Summary: Phase 0: Extract other pipelines' rule sets
Description: Inventory existing gateways; export rules and map to v2 match+runParams. Acceptance: mapping spreadsheet produced. Est: 10-15d (M).
Run replay sample to measure peak messages/sec and memory per-rule snapshot. Acceptance: load report. Est: 3-5d (M).
Ingest historical traffic, deterministic runner for offline validation. Acceptance: deterministic match outputs CLI. Est: 5d (M).

Summary: Extract libs/rule-engine and v2 match model
Description: Move matcher code into libs/rule-engine, add v2 DTOs and validators. Acceptance: Gateway and Rules API compile & run. Est: 8-12d (H).
Snapshot per enabled pipeline, build NTS STRtree, refresh job (~60s). Acceptance: snapshot metric + STRtree query parity. Est: 6-9d (H).
Use RunParamsType validators in Rules API and Gateway; rejected rules logged. Acceptance: API rejects invalid writes; Gateway rejects at load. Est: 4d (H).
Collapse dispatch units by (pipelineId, normalized runParams) and attach contributors. Acceptance: integration shows collapse behavior. Est: 4d (H).
Add IPipelineContract and implement tile-builder contract + golden-file tests. Acceptance: golden-file passes; form descriptor generated. Est: 6d (H).
Create IPipelineContract stub for high-scale; placeholder tests. Acceptance: compiles and integrated. Est: 3d (M).
Support multiple OutputDestinations and DestinationName on envelopes. Acceptance: backward compatible publishers. Est: 4d (H).
Queue consumer that POSTs messages to configured URL with retry/DLQ. Acceptance: stub endpoint integration tests. Est: 6-8d (H).
Add IDispatchTransport implementations and register by transport.kind. Acceptance: Gateway dispatches via configured kinds. Est: 3d (H).
Route resolution by catalog to ES index; CRUD for pipeline rules. Acceptance: CRUD operate on pipeline index. Est: 6d (M).
Validate stored rules against current contract; return failures report. Acceptance: CI sweep report. Est: 4d (M).
Run a proposal against traffic sample and enabled snapshots; return matches + overlaps. Acceptance: simulation returns matches and overlaps. Est: 5-7d (M).

Summary: Audit index write on every mutation
Description: Append-only index writes with changedBy/reason/diff. Acceptance: every mutation produces audit doc. Est: 3d (H).

Summary: Catalog GET for UI with form descriptor generation
Description: Serve GET /pipelines with RunParamsType-derived descriptor. Acceptance: UI can render form from descriptor. Est: 3d (H).
Evaluate usage; port or deprecate. Acceptance: decision documented. Est: 1-2d (L).
Integrate SSO or internal identity; populate changedBy. Acceptance: audit includes actor. Est: 3-20d (L).

Summary: Reindex transform for v1->v2 and dual-write support
Description: Transform script, dual-write option in Rules API, alias cutover. Acceptance: rollback safe with byte-identical outputs. Est: 6-10d (M).

Summary: Author other pipelines' rules into new indexes
Description: Express existing rules as match+runParams in their indexes and verify by replay. Acceptance: critical rules in v2 indexes. Est: 8-20d (M).
Pipeline list, rule list, enable toggle, simulate button (links). Acceptance: product can view and toggle. Est: 8-12d (M).

Summary: Dynamic form generator from contract descriptor (client)
Description: Client-side form renderer for RunParamsType descriptor. Acceptance: can author rule with typed validation. Est: 10-15d (M).
Polygon WKT editor, draw/modify, self-hosted tiles. Acceptance: saves valid locationWkt and preview. Est: 10-20d (L).
Mark rules pending approval and approval flow. Acceptance: gated rules require approval. Est: 6-10d (M).
Run Gateway in shadow mode for new pipelines, collect diffs vs old gateways. Acceptance: diff report with explained differences. Est: 6-10d (M).
Cutover plan, runbook, rollback steps. Acceptance: old gateways retired safely. Est: 4-6d (M).
